subject: registration
asserts: adapter is a new registry entry; no core file names it

subject: detect
asserts: fake executable found, version read, help checked; no model call

subject: version
asserts: outside range gives a doctor warning; change between passes warns

subject: credential
asserts: key by environment, never argument; missing key fails before pass 1

subject: terms
asserts: provider row decides; unknown provider warns and is never auto-picked

subject: tier3
asserts: OAuth path of a Claude subscription refused for both audiences; no process starts

subject: no-login
asserts: no login command among the calls; no auth or trust file written

subject: containment
asserts: no opt-in: launch refused, doctor line; opt-in: protection=detect

subject: parallel
asserts: off unless allow_detect; reason stated

subject: doctor
asserts: five checks, no write, no paid call

subject: proposer-invocation
asserts: stdin, workdir, allow-list environment, process group

subject: tool-allow-list
asserts: allow-list in the invocation record; no deny list

subject: continuation
asserts: exact id, per-attempt directory, removed at end

subject: fresh-session
asserts: each listed case starts fresh; no session kept where none can follow; parity: none kept

subject: home
asserts: real home untouched at Tier 1; overlay removed at Tier 2 even when killed

subject: telemetry-off
asserts: switch in the environment of every process; a process that ignores it is still handled

subject: project-trust
asserts: no approval option; ignore option passed; fake project resource not loaded

subject: critic-flags
asserts: full flag set; no flag that allows a tool

subject: critic-proof

subject: critic-session
asserts: no critic record carries a session id a pass used

subject: critic-forms
asserts: only tool-less; auto-pick only as tested and with the provider's row

subject: window
asserts: smaller of declared and effective; unknown model not offered

subject: dialect
asserts: recorded streams pass the reader; header version 2 gives unsupported-schema terminal; no terminal gives missing_terminal

subject: classifier
asserts: error text with reset time and without

subject: terminal
asserts: success decided by terminal record whatever the exit code

subject: usage
asserts: increments per message; cost null when absent

subject: captures
asserts: four captures on disk with logs

subject: conformance

subject: context-off
asserts: customisations and native memory off for the proposer by default; opt-in recorded
